description: This file defines a pure virtual interface for managing RDK windows within the WPEFramework. It includes nested notification interfaces for application state changes and various methods for window creation, app management, input interception, focus and visibility controls, and event querying.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: Interface for managing RDK window operations, including display creation, app focus, visibility, key event handling, and notification registration.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface to receive events such as user inactivity, app connection/disconnection, and visibility and focus changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification handler for window events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification handler.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager service with a provided shell interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the window manager service.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display window with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently active applications.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Registers a key intercept for a specific key and client.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Registers multiple key intercepts in one call.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept for a specific key and client.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Registers listeners for specified keys.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes key listeners.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a key event for specified keys on behalf of a client.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables inactivity reporting.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity interval.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeats.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Sets whether key inputs are ignored.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat parameters.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to a specified app or client.

methods.name: SetVisible
methods.description: Sets visibility of a specified client or app.

methods.name: RenderReady
methods.description: Checks if the first frame for a client/application has been rendered.

methods.name: EnableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables Wayland display rendering for a client.

methods.name: GetLastKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the last key press event, including key code, modifiers, and timestamp.
